hero.title: Perimeter Warning Lights
hero.subtitle: Install additional warning around the perimeter of your vehicle — vehicle-specific D-pillar and running-board lights, compact surface-mount warning lights, and high-output zone lighting for police and fire apparatus.

description: Federal Signal perimeter lights extend warning coverage around the full profile of the vehicle. Choose vehicle-specific D-pillar and running-board fixtures, compact surface-mount lights, or high-output zone lighting for fire apparatus.

_catalog_notes.sku_counts: MicroPulse Ultra (8), Xstream Warning Lights (13), DynaFlare Perimeter (7), FireRay LED Perimeter (45 core + 28 accessory), and SpectraLux ILS (73) variant counts reflect confirmed SKUs in shopify-variant-index.json as of 2026-07-06/07. Prior sprint specs referenced higher counts for several of these families — see each product's _commerce_note for the discrepancy.
